newsitem.title: CANADA: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CANADA, March 25 - Vancouver, BC - GRAIN - 5 Vessels loading, 13 waiting. Delays are estimated at two weeks or less, depending on grade to be loaded. By mid-April it is estimated that delays will be 1 week or less. Roberts Bank - COAL - 2 Vessels loading, 1 waiting, 3 vessels due. 27 Positions scheduled for loading in April. Prince Rupert - GRAIN - 1 Vessel loading, 9 waiting. Delays of 2 weeks or less.

HONDURAS, March 24 - Puerto Cortes - Eight vessels berthed of which 4 discharging/loading containers/generals, 1 each discharging corn, wheat, potash, paper/loading lumber. 1 Vessel in ballast at anchor. 14 Vessels due of which 1 passenger, 7 to discharge/load containers/generals, 6 to discharge/load containers/bananas. Vessels berthed, 4 discharging/loading containers, 1 each discharging wheat, potash, 1 loading sugar, 1 discharging paper rolls. Vessels due, 5 to discharge bananas, 1 passenger, 8 to load/discharge containers, 1 each to discharge fertiliser, urea, wheat/corn.

MEXICO, March 25 - Tampico - In port, 1 general cargo, 1 steel coils, 2 minerals, 1 cement. Altamira - In port, 3 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 repair. Veracruz - In port, 2 cars, 3 sugar, 2 corn, 1 scrap, 2 containers, 1 general cargo, 3 grain, 2 tankers anchored, 1 other tanker. Manzanillo - In port - 3 General cargo, 1 fruit, 2 containers, 1 steel coils, 1 grain. Coatzacoalco- In port, 7 chemicals, 9 oil tankers. All ports working normally.

PANAMA, March 24 - Cristobal - Ten vessels alongside operating, 1 passenger vessel. Balboa - 24 Vessels alongside operating, 5 cargo operations, 1 passenger vessel. Panama Canal - Waterway and transit booking system working to full capacity. 42 Vessels due, 22 in queue, 9 booked, 40 scheduled.
